metadata.title: Capgo | Plugins — Open-source Capacitor plugins and SDK
metadata.description: Open-source Capacitor plugins and SDK bridges for teams that need native features without owning every Swift, Kotlin, or vendor SDK edge case.

blocks.text: Stop burning sprints on native bridge code. Pick production-ready Capacitor plugins and SDK wrappers backed by real npm usage, GitHub signal, and open-source maintenance.
Every Capgo plugin is free to use under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, including in commercial apps. Read, fork, and audit the source on GitHub.
Priority support with a Capgo plan
Customers on any Capgo plan get their plugin bug fixes and feature requests handled first by the team that maintains them.
Find the Native Capability You Need
Ship auth, payments, biometrics, background tasks, and SDK wrappers without rebuilding the native bridge from scratch.
